sql_query:
SELECT
    o.oid,
    o.ndet,
    o.firstmjd,
    o.lastmjd,
    p.probability,
    ss.candid,
    ss.ssdistnr,
    ss.ssnamenr,
    o.firstmjd AS detection_date,
    NULL AS fid /* filter identifier is not available in the provided schema */
FROM object o
INNER JOIN probability p
    ON o.oid = p.oid
    AND p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
    AND p.class_name = 'asteroid'
    AND p.probability > 0.5
INNER JOIN ss_ztf ss
    ON o.oid = ss.oid
    AND ss.ssdistnr < 2
WHERE o.ndet > 500
ORDER BY o.firstmjd ASC
LIMIT 10

    o.oid,                /* ZTF identifier */
    o.ndet,               /* number of detections */
    o.firstmjd,           /* first detection date */
    o.lastmjd,            /* last detection date */
    p.probability,        /* probability of being an asteroid */
    ss.candid,            /* candidate identifier */
    ss.ssdistnr,          /* distance between ZTF object and MPC object (arcsec) */

FROM object o
INNER JOIN probability p ON o.oid = p.oid
INNER JOIN ss_ztf ss ON o.oid = ss.oid
WHERE o.ndet > 500

  AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
  AND p.probability > 0.5
  AND ss.ssdistnr < 2
ORDER BY o.firstmjd ASC
LIMIT 10
